title: Maddy Dewey
text:
Purpose-Driven Problem Solver | Where People, Data, and Water Intersect

My focus is water resources. I’ve spent the past decade honing skills in stakeholder relations and data science, ultimately searching for a meaningful field to apply myself. My lightbulb moment struck when I learned about work in water; it’s dynamic, community-centered, data-driven, and multidisciplinary. That has become my why.
